name: Río de Oro (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and red, the white charged with two grey five-pointed stars joined by a curved line.
history: Municipal flag of Río de Oro, a municipality in the department of Cesar, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: two stars joined by a curved line
